title: Studio Data › Settings › Lifecycle field is a dead end: picking a Studio-authored select is refused 422 because its options need `kind`, and the options editor has no `kind` control
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The builder can create a status picklist and choose it as the lifecycle field, but the save is refused and Studio offers no way to add what the refusal asks for.

## Reproduction

1. Data › an object › add a select field `status` with options new/won/lost (Studio options editor).
2. Settings › Lifecycle field → choose `status` → 422 "Option 'new' of field `status` declares no `kind` … Add kind: 'open'|'won'|'lost'".
3. The options editor has no kind control; only the API can fix it.

## Expected

The options editor authors `kind` (open/won/lost) when the field is (or becomes) the stage field, or the picker explains and offers it inline.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` ObjectSettingsPanel (~lines 340-356) and the ObjectFieldInspector options editor; spec rule in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (~466).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data QA card.
- Business reason: Lifecycle paths and kanban (see open #26612) depend on `kind`; without a Studio control the feature is reachable only through code.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio lifecycle stageField select option kind open won lost no control in options editor` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 3 hits: open #26612 (renderers reading kind, not authoring) and closed #23809, #11243; no duplicate.
- QA id: U2
